evidence.quote: nearly all Committee participants view it as likely that some further rate increases will be appropriate this year to bring inflation down to 2 percent over time.
not a single person on the Committee wrote down a rate cut this year, nor do I think it is at all likely to be appropriate, if you think about it.
inflation pressures continue to run high, and the process of getting inflation back down to 2 percent has a long way to go.
I still think, and my, my colleagues agree, that, that the risks to inflation are to the upside still.
The labor market remains very tight.
we judged it prudent to hold the target range steady to allow the Committee to assess additional information and its implications for monetary policy.

parsed.rationale: The Chair announced a pause but paired it with strong guidance that further hikes are likely this year, upside inflation risks, little core inflation progress, and no cuts this year. The hold and moderated pace temper the signal, making the net stance a hawkish pause.
